info.description:
***IMPORTANT! READ THIS BEFORE TEST***

When entering the token in Swagger Authorization:
**"Bearer {YOUR-ACCESS-TOKEN}"**
Make sure to include Bearer before your access token

Always open **"DevTools (F12) -> Application -> Cookies"**
For getting the latest Refresh Token and Session ID cookie in real time
Works with HttpOnly cookies, which are protected from JavaScript access.
